'''Danteel City''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Danteel]]. The [[High Card Casino]] operated in the [[City/Legends|city]] and during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] [[Veilred Jydor]] hosted a [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] tournament there, the prize for which was a rare [[Tchine]] statue. The [[Danteel City Police]] was responsible for law enforcement in the city.
